Theorem
[Instability of non-maximizers (Theorem 35.42)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0327 1. ch35:35.42\group Alternative Stability Methods

If a compact Ricci-flat metric $\hat g$ is not a local maximizer of $\lambda $, there exists a nontrivial ancient Ricci flow converging modulo diffeomorphisms to $\hat g$ as $t\to -\infty $.
